idea-plugin.name: JPA 3D
idea-plugin.description:
See your JPA entity model the way you reason about it — as a living graph, right inside the IDE. JPA 3D reads your @Entity classes (Java & Kotlin) and renders them as an interactive 3D force-directed graph or a 2D orthogonal ERD, so relationships, inheritance, and Spring Data repositories become something you can actually look at, navigate, and share.

JPA 3D is intended to:
  • Make a large JPA model understandable at a glance — no more reading annotations file by file
  • Help you trace how entities connect, where the foreign keys are, and how inheritance is mapped
  • Turn your code into shareable artifacts — diagrams, DDL, and Mermaid — in a couple of clicks

JPA 3D delivers:
  • A 3D / 2D viewer that stays in sync with your source — click any node to jump to its file
  • Accurate analysis of relationships, cardinality, inheritance, and Spring Data repositories
  • One-click export to JSON, DDL (PostgreSQL / MySQL / H2 / Oracle), Mermaid, and PNG / SVG

It works in any project using Spring Boot, Jakarta EE, or plain JPA — with both jakarta.persistence and legacy javax.persistence, in Java and Kotlin.

Most loved features

Explore your model in 3D & 2D
  • 3D force-directed graph with entity-card sprites and depth anchors
  • 2D orthogonal ERD with clean layered routing (elkjs)
  • 3D minimap — a projected overview of every node; click to fly the camera there (keeps zoom)
  • Manual layout overrides — drag nodes in 2D, reset anytime
Focus on what matters
  • Centers (seeds) — focus on several entities and packages at once; each shows as a removable chip
  • Connection depth slider — widen or narrow the neighborhood in real time (client-side, no re-query)
  • Add a package from the Project view — right-click a package to center on it (sub-packages included)
  • Search highlighting — type to fade non-matching nodes; column-hover spotlights an entity's edges
Read the mapping accurately
  • Crow's foot cardinality for @OneToMany, @ManyToOne, @OneToOne, @ManyToMany
  • @Inheritance badges (SINGLE_TABLE / JOINED / TABLE_PER_CLASS) with @DiscriminatorColumn / @DiscriminatorValue
  • Multi-level Spring Data repository inheritance — follows custom intermediate interfaces (MyBaseRepo<T> extends JpaRepository<T,ID>)
  • FK columns on cards for @ManyToOne / owning @OneToOne with @JoinColumn name resolution
  • @Table indexes / uniqueConstraints as column glyphs (◆ unique, # indexed), plus PK / FK / nullable / unique / length / @GeneratedValue / @Column(name)
  • Bidirectional relationships are de-duplicated automatically (drops mappedBy mirror edges)
Get it out of the IDE
  • Export via Tools → JPA 3D: Export… to JSON, DDL (optional snake_case & DROP TABLE), Mermaid, and viewer snapshots (PNG / SVG)
  • Extract single-entity SQL — an icon on the @Entity editor banner dumps that entity's DDL
  • Add to viewer from the editor — center the graph on the entity you're reading without leaving the file
Built to stay out of your way
  • Java & Kotlin via UAST — Kotlin annotation use-site targets handled transparently
  • Background analysis — the cache pre-warms after indexing, with no UI freezes
  • Settings page (Settings → Tools → JPA 3D) — persist viewer, analysis-filter, and export defaults

Getting started
Open your JPA project, let indexing finish, then open the JPA 3D tool window on the right. Hit Sync to analyze, and start exploring. Enjoy!

한국어
JPA 엔티티 모델을 IDE 안에서 3D / 2D ERD 로 시각화하고 탐색하는 플러그인입니다. @Entity 클래스(Java & Kotlin)를 분석해 관계·카디널리티·상속·Spring Data 리포지토리를 그래프로 보여주고, 노드를 클릭하면 소스로 바로 이동합니다.
  • 3D 포스 그래프 / 2D 직교 ERD, 3D 미니맵, 깊이 슬라이더로 원하는 범위만 집중
  • crow's foot 카디널리티, @Inheritance 전략, FK 컬럼, 인덱스/유니크 제약까지 정확히 표현
  • 다단계 Spring Data 리포지토리 상속과 jakarta / 레거시 javax persistence 모두 지원
  • 모델을 JSON / DDL(PostgreSQL · MySQL · H2 · Oracle) / Mermaid / PNG · SVG 로 내보내기
프로젝트 인덱싱 후 우측 JPA 3D 툴윈도우를 열고 동기화하면 됩니다.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.5.5
  • Right-click now removes a node from the analysis — instead of just hiding it, distances and the depth filter are recomputed, so neighbors that were only reachable through the removed node disappear with it (cascade). In all scope, only nodes that became orphaned by the removal are pruned — originally independent entities are kept. Undo with Cmd/Ctrl+Z, or restore from the toolbar.
0.5.4
  • Fixed a PluginException when opening Settings — the JPA 3D sub-tabs (Viewer / Analysis / Export / Editor) are now provided as composite children of the parent page instead of separate extension points. The platform no longer logs No display name specified… nor eagerly loads each tab class, while the tab names still follow the plugin language setting.
0.5.3
  • No more UI freezes on large projects — the full-project scan now runs as a cancellable non-blocking read action. Previously it held the read lock for the whole scan, so clicking or typing in the editor mid-analysis could freeze the IDE for several seconds; the scan now yields to those actions and retries.
0.4.1
  • Fixed split navigation crash on 2025.3 / 2026.1 / 2026.2 — the 2×2 grid open (Cmd/Ctrl+click) referenced an EditorWindow.split overload that became binary-incompatible after a new parameter was added; now calls the stable overload directly.
  • Replaced the deprecated SimpleListCellRenderer.create (scheduled for removal in 2026.2) with textListCellRenderer in the Settings combo box.
0.4.0
  • Multiple centers (seeds) — the center scope now accepts several seeds at once, mixing entities and packages freely. Search adds each pick as a removable chip; depth is the shortest hop from any selected seed (union BFS).
  • Add a package from the Project view — right-click a package → JPA 3D: 이 패키지 추가 to open the tool window and add that package (with its sub-packages) as a center.
  • Split navigation — Cmd/Ctrl+click a node to open its source in a 2×2 editor grid, so several entities can be compared side by side.
0.3.2
  • Removed deprecated / scheduled-for-removal platform API usages (addBrowseFolderListener, SimpleListCellRenderer.create, runReadAction) for forward compatibility with current and upcoming IDEs.
  • Minimum supported IDE raised to 2024.3 (build 243).
0.3.1
  • 3D minimap — overview of all nodes projected onto the layer plane with the current view box; click to fly the camera there (keeps zoom).
0.3.0
  • Settings page under Settings → Tools → JPA 3D — persist viewer defaults (view / scope / depth / display options), analysis package include/exclude filters, and Export defaults (DDL dialect / snake_case / DROP TABLE).
  • Connection depth slider — drag to adjust the seed neighborhood depth; filtering is client-side so it responds in real time without re-querying.
0.2.1
  • New plugin icon (DNA double helix).
  • Replaced deprecated ReadAction.compute(ThrowableComputable) usages with Kotlin runReadAction { }.
0.2.0
  • 3D rendering overhauled: entity-card sprites with 3D anchor spheres for real depth perception.
  • 2D ERD: crow's foot cardinality markers; manual node drag with position reset.
  • Search match highlighting — type in the search box to fade non-matching nodes and edges.
  • Column hover spotlights connected edges of that entity.
  • @Inheritance strategy badge (SINGLE_TABLE / JOINED / TABLE_PER_CLASS) with discriminator info.
  • FK columns shown on entity cards for @ManyToOne / owning @OneToOne, including @JoinColumn(name) resolution.
  • @Table indexes / uniqueConstraints rendered as column glyphs.
  • Multi-level Spring Data repository inheritance is now followed through user-defined intermediate interfaces.
  • Edge labels include the FK column name when available.
  • Background cache warming — analysis runs in a pooled thread after indexing finishes; viewer auto-retries while the IDE is still indexing.
0.1.0
  • Initial release.
  • 3D / 2D ERD views with elkjs orthogonal routing.
  • UAST-based analyzer for Java and Kotlin entities.
  • Spring Data Repository detection.
